title: Finite-field internal Hom from a finite local system
statement: Let $A$ be a finite field and $S$ a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Use ordinary uncompleted derived categories of module sheaves over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal B_A(T)$ for the complexes whose cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval and is constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]: there is a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which each cohomology sheaf is pro-étale locally constant with finite-dimensional $A$-module values. Let $L$ be an $A_S$-module sheaf admitting a pro-étale covering on each member of which it is a constant finite-dimensional $A$-module [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]. For integers $a\le b$ and $N\in\mathcal B_A(S)$ with $H^r(N)=0$ outside $[a,b]$, the ambient ringed-site $R\mathcal Hom_{A_S}(L[0],N)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] belongs to $\mathcal B_A(S)$ and has cohomology zero outside the same interval $[a,b]$. More precisely, with $L^\vee=\mathcal Hom_{A_S}(L,A_S)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], there are natural isomorphisms $H^rR\mathcal Hom_{A_S}(L,N)\cong L^\vee\otimes_{A_S}H^r(N)$ for all $r$.

source.place: Lemma 6.7.13, local-system case of the finite-coefficient computation, using the ringed-site perfect-dual formula.
